title: Show HN: The same nine streaming subscriptions cost $702/year more than in 2021
summary: An article tracking how the cost of nine popular streaming subscriptions has increased by $702/year since 2021, demonstrating the growing financial burden of digital entertainment services. The analysis comes from Honestly Ranked, a consumer-focused comparison platform, and was shared on Hacker News where it gained significant community engagement.
problem_solved: Quantifies the dramatic price increases in streaming subscriptions over the past 3 years to help consumers understand their growing media costs.
why_valuable: Provides transparency on streaming service pricing trends, empowering consumers to make informed decisions about their entertainment budgets.
